title: Subjective awareness is the brain’s internal model of attention

statements.text: Subjective awareness is the brain's internal model of the process of attention. The content of that model leads a brain to conclude that it has a subjective experience, and subjective reports such as 'I am aware of X' report the contents of the model.

sources.quote: In a nutshell, the theory proposes that subjective awareness is the brain’s internal model of the process of attention.
the content of this model is the basis of subjective reports
